title: Two Swaps, One Total: How Much Money Do They Have? | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
Ali and Bea each have some money, and two different swaps give us two clues. Can you find how much they have together?
We draw bars to see what each clue means, then turn the clues into a balance and solve it step by step.
Try it yourself when the countdown shows up, then take on a new pair of clues!
